Method of Attack: Unauthenticated read and write access to Azure Cosmos DB containers via Jupyter Notebooks due to lack of authentication checks
Exploitation of Notebook Workspace UUID (forwardingId) to gain full permissions without authentication
Modification of Notebook code, overwriting data, injecting or deleting snippets
Injection of Python code into Data Explorer module to spawn reverse shell on client
Attack Vector: Knowledge of Notebook Workspace UUID (forwardingId) to bypass authentication
Requests without Authorization Header to list and modify Notebooks
Indicators of Compromise: Unauthorized access and modification of Cosmos DB Jupyter Notebooks
Injected Python code executing reverse shell on client via Data Explorer
